name: How long does bathroom tub installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom tub installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard tub installation usually takes a day or two, but the timeline depends on demolition, plumbing changes, and whether the surround also needs replacement. If the subfloor, drain, or wall framing has damage, the job can take longer. For homes in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the fastest way to get a reliable timeline is an on-site inspection before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most tub installations take 1–2 days, but plumbing, demolition, and hidden damage can add time. An on-site inspection is the best way to get a realistic schedule.
